shells.label: Course with left outline
shells.useWhen: Long, resumable, multi-module or compliance learning where learners need location and overview.
shells.completion: ULAMS records progress per topic and derives course completion from the ordinary course structure.

shells.label: One-page scroll
shells.useWhen: Short narrative learning that benefits from one continuous reading path and anchored sections.
shells.completion: Stable section and topic identifiers report progress to ULAMS; reaching the page end alone never fabricates completion.

shells.label: Slides
shells.useWhen: Concise, visual, linear material suited to one idea per screen and keyboard or touch navigation.
shells.completion: Stable slide and topic identifiers report progress to ULAMS; assessment and course completion remain server decisions.

capabilities.label: Rich text
capabilities.purpose: Explain concepts with short cited blocks, lists, tables, examples and code listings.
accessibility: Semantic headings and table headers; meaningful link text.

capabilities.label: Callout
capabilities.purpose: Emphasise one key idea, tip or warning without interrupting the reading flow.
accessibility: Meaning cannot depend on colour alone.

capabilities.label: Steps
capabilities.purpose: Show a procedure or ordered process.
accessibility: Preserve semantic list order.

capabilities.label: Comparison table
capabilities.purpose: Compare alternatives against common criteria.
accessibility: Caption and row/column headers are required.

capabilities.label: Timeline
capabilities.purpose: Show a chronological sequence or stages where order matters.
capabilities.fallback: Ordered list with dates or stage labels
accessibility: The DOM reading order must match chronology.

capabilities.label: Flip cards
capabilities.purpose: Prompt low-stakes retrieval of terms, definitions or concise answers.
accessibility: Reveal controls must be keyboard accessible and expose state.

capabilities.label: Code block
capabilities.purpose: Present source-supported code or commands for reading and copying.
accessibility: Code stays selectable text and does not rely on syntax colour.

capabilities.label: Scaffolded practice activity
capabilities.purpose: Guide practice from prior knowledge through hints, feedback and a worked solution.
capabilities.fallback: Toolbox, challenges, hints and worked solution as structured text
accessibility: Hints and solutions expose state; focus moves predictably after an attempt.

capabilities.label: Tracked GIFT quiz
capabilities.purpose: Run scored or unscored assessment attempts with explanations and server-side tracking.
accessibility: Every control has a label; errors and results are announced.
capabilities.notes: Supports single/multiple choice, true-false, short answer, matching, numerical, essay and description. Essay needs human grading.

capabilities.label: GIFT single choice
capabilities.purpose: Assess one source-supported best answer with an explanation.
capabilities.fallback: Question, options and explanation as text
accessibility: Radio controls, errors and feedback need labels and announcements.

capabilities.label: GIFT multiple response
capabilities.purpose: Assess several source-supported correct choices with an explanation.
capabilities.fallback: Question, options and explanation as text
accessibility: Checkbox controls, errors and feedback need labels and announcements.

capabilities.label: GIFT true/false
capabilities.purpose: Check one source-supported binary claim with explanatory feedback.
capabilities.fallback: Statement, answer and explanation as text
accessibility: Controls and feedback need labels and announcements.

capabilities.label: GIFT short answer
capabilities.purpose: Require learners to retrieve a short source-supported answer.
accessibility: The input needs a label and accepted variants must not depend on punctuation alone.

capabilities.label: GIFT matching
capabilities.purpose: Match source-supported terms, examples or paired concepts.
accessibility: Use labelled selects or another non-drag keyboard interaction.

capabilities.label: GIFT numerical
capabilities.purpose: Assess a numerical answer with an explicit tolerance where appropriate.
capabilities.fallback: Numerical prompt, units and worked answer
accessibility: State units, format and tolerance in text.

capabilities.label: GIFT essay
capabilities.purpose: Collect a longer learner response for human grading.
accessibility: The textarea needs a label and grading expectations.
capabilities.notes: Never claim automatic grading; a teacher grades the response.

capabilities.label: GIFT description
capabilities.purpose: Insert ungraded instructions or context inside a quiz.
accessibility: Use semantic text and heading order.

capabilities.label: Video
capabilities.purpose: Demonstrate a process, event or visual change over time.
accessibility: Captions, transcript, keyboard controls and audio description when needed.

capabilities.label: Audio
capabilities.purpose: Teach listening, pronunciation, dialogue or narrated material.
accessibility: A complete transcript and keyboard controls are required.

capabilities.label: Image or figure
capabilities.purpose: Show a source image, diagram, screenshot or labelled figure.
accessibility: Meaningful alt text or a long description; decorative images use empty alt.

capabilities.label: PDF
capabilities.purpose: Provide an original document for reference alongside extracted accessible content.
capabilities.fallback: Extracted accessible text or download link
accessibility: Do not rely on an inaccessible PDF as the only learning content.

capabilities.label: oEmbed media
capabilities.purpose: Embed author-approved media from a configured provider.
capabilities.fallback: Accessible link, transcript and author-provided summary
accessibility: The provider needs captions/transcript, keyboard controls and a privacy review.

capabilities.label: Project submission
capabilities.purpose: Collect a learner-created file or artefact for human review.
capabilities.fallback: Assignment instructions and an accessible submission form
accessibility: Instructions name accepted formats and an alternative submission route.

capabilities.label: LiaScript
capabilities.purpose: Deliver interactive Markdown with self-checks, media, diagrams and safe configured runtimes.
accessibility: Keep a readable Markdown path and avoid model-authored scripts or imports.

capabilities.label: Declarative layout topic
capabilities.purpose: Compose an entire lesson from approved, schema-validated learner components.
capabilities.fallback: Required Markdown fallback stored with the topic
accessibility: Every component must pass its schema and WCAG checks; reading order stays linear.

capabilities.label: Curated interactive package
capabilities.purpose: Use a reviewed interactive JS package from the tenant library.
capabilities.fallback: Package-provided text alternative and reduced-motion poster
accessibility: Keyboard path, text alternative, reduced-motion poster and non-drag controls are required.

capabilities.label: SCORM package
capabilities.purpose: Reuse an existing SCORM 1.2 or 2004 learning package.
accessibility: Accessibility is package-owned and must be checked before publication.

capabilities.label: Adapt Learning course
capabilities.purpose: Import a built Adapt SCORM package or build validated Adapt JSON through the isolated worker.
capabilities.fallback: Author-provided accessible summary or source content
accessibility: The built package needs its own keyboard, screen-reader and contrast review.

capabilities.label: cmi5 package
capabilities.purpose: Run an xAPI-based assignable unit with standardized launch and progress.
accessibility: Accessibility is package-owned and must be checked before publication.

capabilities.label: LTI 1.3 tool
capabilities.purpose: Launch a registered external learning tool with optional grade passback.
capabilities.fallback: Author-provided explanation and accessible external link
accessibility: The external tool needs its own accessibility review.

capabilities.label: Generated simulation
capabilities.purpose: Create an open-ended interactive only when the approved catalogue cannot express the objective.
capabilities.fallback: Static worked example and text-based practice
accessibility: Requires sandboxing, solvability tests, keyboard access and an equivalent text activity.
capabilities.notes: Future feature: isolated origin, no network, typed bridge and explicit author approval.

capabilities.label: H5P Fill in the Blanks
capabilities.purpose: Retrieve short source-supported terms, numbers or facts in context.
accessibility: Inputs need labels and feedback must not depend on colour.

capabilities.label: H5P Drag the Words
capabilities.purpose: Place source-supported words into gaps.
capabilities.fallback: Select-based gap task or text questions
accessibility: A click/select and keyboard alternative to dragging is required.

capabilities.label: H5P Dialog Cards
capabilities.purpose: Practise term-definition or question-answer retrieval.
accessibility: Card fronts, backs and reveal state must be screen-reader accessible.

capabilities.label: H5P Interactive Video
capabilities.purpose: Add questions and navigation to a supplied video.
capabilities.fallback: Captioned video, transcript and separate quiz
accessibility: Captions, transcript, audio description and keyboard-operable overlays are required.

capabilities.label: H5P Course Presentation
capabilities.purpose: Present imported interactive slides inside a lesson.
accessibility: Slide order, focus order and every embedded interaction need review.
capabilities.notes: This is a lesson building block, not the global ULAMS slides shell.

capabilities.label: H5P Branching Scenario
capabilities.purpose: Practise decisions and consequences through a supplied branching case.
capabilities.fallback: Numbered text scenario with explicit choices and consequences
accessibility: Every branch must be reachable by keyboard and make consequences explicit.

capabilities.label: H5P Accordion
capabilities.purpose: Progressively disclose reference content without adding assessment.
accessibility: Buttons expose expanded state and all panels follow heading order.

capabilities.label: H5P Advent Calendar
capabilities.purpose: Reveal scheduled items in a calendar-shaped experience.
accessibility: Calendar doors need names, keyboard access and a chronological list alternative.

capabilities.label: H5P Agamotto
capabilities.purpose: Compare a sequence of images that gradually change.
capabilities.fallback: Ordered images with captions and descriptions
accessibility: Every image needs equivalent text and non-drag navigation.

capabilities.label: H5P AR Scavenger
capabilities.purpose: Run an imported augmented-reality scavenger activity.
accessibility: Provide an equivalent route without camera, motion or location dependence.

capabilities.label: H5P Arithmetic Quiz
capabilities.purpose: Practise timed arithmetic fluency.
accessibility: Time limits need adjustment or removal and results must be announced.

capabilities.label: H5P Audio Recorder
capabilities.purpose: Let learners record a spoken response.
accessibility: Offer a text alternative and do not require microphone permission.

capabilities.label: H5P Chart
capabilities.purpose: Show supplied values as a bar or pie chart.
accessibility: Always include the underlying table and do not rely on colour.

capabilities.label: H5P Collage
capabilities.purpose: Arrange several supplied images as one visual overview.
accessibility: Every meaningful image needs alt text and a logical reading order.

capabilities.label: H5P Cornell Notes
capabilities.purpose: Guide learners to capture notes, cues and a summary.
capabilities.fallback: Labelled text fields or downloadable template
accessibility: Fields need persistent labels and saved-state feedback.

capabilities.label: H5P Crossword
capabilities.purpose: Practise vocabulary and short factual recall as a crossword.
accessibility: Provide a linear clue/input mode independent of the visual grid.

capabilities.label: H5P Dictation
capabilities.purpose: Practise listening and writing with supplied audio.
accessibility: Offer volume/replay controls and a non-audio alternative where listening is not the objective.

capabilities.label: H5P Documentation Tool
capabilities.purpose: Guide a learner through a structured form and export their text.
accessibility: Steps, fields and export status require labels and keyboard access.

capabilities.label: H5P Drag and Drop
capabilities.purpose: Place text or images into visual target areas.
capabilities.fallback: Select item then select destination, or matching question
accessibility: A non-drag single-pointer and keyboard method is required.

capabilities.label: H5P Essay
capabilities.purpose: Collect a longer response with keyword-based instant feedback.
accessibility: Textarea and feedback require labels; keyword scoring must be disclosed as limited.

capabilities.label: H5P Find Multiple Hotspots
capabilities.purpose: Identify several target regions in an image.
accessibility: Provide a non-spatial list equivalent and keyboard-operable targets.

capabilities.label: H5P Find the Hotspot
capabilities.purpose: Identify one target region in an image.
capabilities.fallback: Labelled image plus a list question
accessibility: Provide a non-spatial list equivalent and keyboard-operable target.

capabilities.label: H5P Find the Words
capabilities.purpose: Find supplied vocabulary in a letter grid.
accessibility: Provide a linear text alternative independent of visual scanning.

capabilities.label: H5P Flashcards
capabilities.purpose: Practise image and text prompts with short answers.
capabilities.fallback: Question, image description and answer list
accessibility: Images need alt text and card navigation must work by keyboard.

capabilities.label: H5P Game Map
capabilities.purpose: Arrange supplied activities as a visual route or game map.
accessibility: Provide a linear route and do not make map position the only navigation.

capabilities.label: H5P Guess the Answer
capabilities.purpose: Prompt prediction or recall before revealing an answer.
accessibility: Image needs alt text and reveal state must be announced.

capabilities.label: H5P Iframe Embedder
capabilities.purpose: Embed an author-approved external URL or uploaded web files.
capabilities.fallback: Accessible external link and author-provided summary
accessibility: Embedded content needs a title, independent review and a fallback.
capabilities.notes: Network and origin policy must allow the destination; never generate arbitrary embed URLs.

capabilities.label: H5P Image Hotspots
capabilities.purpose: Reveal information attached to regions of a supplied image or diagram.
capabilities.fallback: Labelled figure followed by a hotspot detail list
accessibility: Hotspots need names, keyboard access and an equivalent ordered list.

capabilities.label: H5P Image Juxtaposition
capabilities.purpose: Compare two supplied images before and after or side by side.
capabilities.fallback: Two labelled images with a textual comparison
accessibility: Provide non-drag controls and describe the meaningful differences.

capabilities.label: H5P Image Pairing
capabilities.purpose: Match related supplied images.
accessibility: Images need names and matching needs a non-drag keyboard route.

capabilities.label: H5P Image Sequencing
capabilities.purpose: Put supplied images into the correct order.
accessibility: Images need names and ordering needs non-drag buttons.

capabilities.label: H5P Image Slider
capabilities.purpose: Browse a supplied image sequence.
accessibility: Previous/next buttons, pause where automatic, and meaningful alt text are required.

capabilities.label: H5P Impressive Presentation
capabilities.purpose: Show an imported parallax slide presentation.
accessibility: Disable non-essential motion and provide a linear keyboard-readable alternative.
capabilities.notes: Official H5P type is alpha; do not select automatically.

capabilities.label: H5P Information Wall
capabilities.purpose: Browse and search supplied information panels.
accessibility: Search, filters and panels need labels and predictable focus.

capabilities.label: H5P Interactive Book
capabilities.purpose: Reuse an imported multi-page H5P book or test.
accessibility: Book navigation and every nested content type need review.

capabilities.label: H5P KewAr Code
capabilities.purpose: Display a supplied value as a QR code.
capabilities.fallback: The encoded value as selectable text and a link where applicable
accessibility: The QR code cannot be the only way to access its value.

capabilities.label: H5P Mark the Words
capabilities.purpose: Select source-supported words matching a criterion.
capabilities.fallback: Checkbox list of words or phrases
accessibility: Words need keyboard-selectable controls and visible, announced state.

capabilities.label: H5P Memory Game
capabilities.purpose: Match supplied image or text pairs as a low-stakes game.
accessibility: Cards need names, keyboard access and no memory of position as the learning objective.

capabilities.label: H5P Multimedia Choice
capabilities.purpose: Choose one or more supplied media items as answers.
accessibility: Every media option needs an equivalent accessible name or transcript.

capabilities.label: H5P Multiple Choice
capabilities.purpose: Assess one or several source-supported choices with feedback.
accessibility: Options, validation and explanatory feedback must be labelled and announced.

capabilities.label: H5P Page
capabilities.purpose: Reuse a supplied H5P page layout.
accessibility: Nested components and heading order need review.

capabilities.label: H5P Personality Quiz
capabilities.purpose: Offer a non-assessment categorisation or reflective result.
accessibility: Disclose that results are not validated assessment and make controls accessible.

capabilities.label: H5P Questionnaire
capabilities.purpose: Collect ungraded learner feedback or reflection.
accessibility: Questions and scales need labels; explain privacy and storage.

capabilities.label: H5P Quiz (Question Set)
capabilities.purpose: Run a sequence of imported H5P question types.
accessibility: Question navigation, controls and feedback need end-to-end review.

capabilities.label: H5P Single Choice Set
capabilities.purpose: Run a quick sequence of single-answer questions.
accessibility: Question changes and feedback must be announced.

capabilities.label: H5P Sort the Paragraphs
capabilities.purpose: Put text blocks into a source-supported order.
capabilities.fallback: Paragraphs with move-up/down controls or a numbered-answer question
accessibility: A non-drag keyboard and single-pointer ordering method is required.

capabilities.label: H5P Speak the Words
capabilities.purpose: Practise one spoken answer through browser speech recognition.
accessibility: Never require speech input; provide text and recording alternatives.

capabilities.label: H5P Speak the Words Set
capabilities.purpose: Practise a series of spoken answers through browser speech recognition.
capabilities.fallback: Typed-answer question set or uploaded recording
accessibility: Never require speech input; provide text and recording alternatives.

capabilities.label: H5P Structure Strip
capabilities.purpose: Build or inspect the structure of a text or process.
accessibility: Structure and controls need semantic labels and keyboard order.

capabilities.label: H5P Summary
capabilities.purpose: Choose the correct key statement from successive sets.
accessibility: Successive question changes and feedback must be announced.

capabilities.label: H5P Timeline
capabilities.purpose: Show supplied dated events with optional media.
capabilities.fallback: ULAMS Timeline layout or ordered date list
accessibility: Chronological reading order and media alternatives are required.

capabilities.label: H5P True/False Question
capabilities.purpose: Check one source-supported binary claim with explanation.
accessibility: Controls and explanatory feedback must be labelled and announced.

capabilities.label: H5P Virtual Tour (360)
capabilities.purpose: Explore supplied 360-degree scenes and hotspots.
capabilities.fallback: Flat images, hotspot list and text route
accessibility: Provide non-motion controls and a complete non-spatial alternative.

capabilities.label: H5P Complex Fill in the Blanks
capabilities.purpose: Complete richer gap tasks from supplied authored content.
accessibility: Every blank needs context, label and announced feedback.
